newsitem.title: USA: Versa sees Q2 EPS reduced by Moxness sale.
newsitem.headline: Versa sees Q2 EPS reduced by Moxness sale.

text.p: Versa Technologies Inc said it expects second quarter earnings to be reduced by $0.08 per share due to the completed sale for about $3.4 million of its Moxness Thermoplastics unit to General Plastics Corp.
The company's fiscal year ends March 31, 1997. Earnings in the preceding second quarter were $0.25 per share.
The company said it is comfortable with analysts' estimates for fiscal 1997 earnings of $1.10 per share, before adjustment for the effect of the Moxness Thermoplastics sale.
Versa makes silicone rubber and plastic parts, cyclinders and other products for various industrial and medical markets.
